scope: Full libghostty-vt compatibility; native app/font/GPU validation is separate.
rules: Thorough may pass only when every requirement is complete, exported by both adapters and exercised by passing cases.
A smoke pass is not a full-parity claim. Snapshot comparison alone is insufficient.

requirements.remaining: Control-sequence cases and upstream fuzz corpus have not all been ported.
Reflow, height changes, scrollback pruning and tracked references need complete cases.
Mode/cursor defaults, saved bits, color persistence, RIS and direct resets are compared; graphics and other reset state still need complete coverage.
Mode saved/default state, colors and cursor/mouse transition effects are optionally observed; saved cursor, viewport and complete continuation remain.
Cell comparison exists; complete grapheme, protection, wide-cell and semantic cases remain.
Style comparison exists; all SGR/state transitions remain to be exercised.
Both screens/history are observed; complete screen-switch behavior remains.
Cursor shape, visibility/blink and configured reset defaults are compared; saved cursor and all motion cases remain.
Host query decisions, mode reports and xterm/Kitty color replies are compared; disabled PTY writes and complete control contexts remain.

Raw bytes, UTF-8 validation before truncation, fixed capture/prefix behavior, direct setters and snapshot restoration are compared; disabled callbacks, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.
Opaque raw bytes, OSC7/ConEmu/iTerm2 aliases, fixed capture/prefix behavior, uncapped setters and snapshots are compared; disabled callbacks, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.
BEL callback is observed; parser contexts and notification interaction remain.
All 1,112,064 valid Unicode scalar widths are compared; invalid scalar boundaries are rejected. Grapheme composition is tracked under terminal.cells.

Raw parser/UTF-8 events and inherited parser corpora are compared; exhaustive transition/boundary combinations and capture-limit behavior remain. Raw OSC observation does not validate command semantics.

Validated title/PWD, color, notification and clipboard semantics plus fixed capture/prefix cases are compared; remaining OSC commands, streaming capture allocation and complete malformed contexts remain.

All current source modes, raw saved/default bits, guarded reset policy, DECRQM and basic stream/mouse/cursor transitions are compared; complete cross-mode interactions and screen/input behavior remain.

Current/default/override state, all palette indices, native X11 names, RGB/intensity parsing and xterm/Kitty reply matrices are compared; intermediate capture/continuation, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.
Selection extraction, rectangular/wide/grapheme bounds and viewport.
Regex/literal search across wraps/history and tracked results.
Tracked references through reflow, erasure and pruning.
Image pixels, placement, virtual placement, animation with deterministic clocks.
Install real PNG decoding in the Zig oracle and compare decoded pixels.
Custom glyph uploads, rendering state and resource limits.

OSC 52/5522 metadata, binary reads/writes, MIME filtering, streamed base64, aliases, statuses, callback absence, configured limits, session grants and one-time paste grants are compared; OSC 1337, allocation failures and complete capture/size limits remain.
Host and terminal directions of Kitty drag/drop state.
All named keys in the native legacy/Kitty tables, text fallback, IME, modifier-side bits and macOS Option policies are compared; host event mapping and complete text/control combinations remain.
All mouse modes/formats, buttons and viewport/pixel cases pass; retained motion deduplication, renderer padding and full coordinate-limit cases remain.

Focus, binary paste encodings, safety checks, mode precedence, Kitty paste events, one-time grants, lazy readers and entropy/read errors are compared; disabled output callbacks, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.
Current source terminfo capabilities, host-specified names and DECRQSS styles/margins/cursor replies pass; all control contexts and resource limits remain.

OSC9/777 notification bytes, ConEmu classification/progress/fresh prompts, fixed captures and explicit host query decisions are compared; Kitty notifications and disabled callback combinations remain.
Both encodings are decoded in both peers and compared to uninterrupted continuation; complete metadata, lazy mixed-width PAGEs and all state transitions still need coverage.
READY/history/FINISH state and source offsets are compared with live mutations and transport tails; complete reset-generation behavior, continuation replay, I/O failures and limits remain.

Complete-v1, every truncation and selected corruptions are compared; remaining component fixtures and mixed PAGE behavior need coverage. Original Zig asserts on some mixed-width cursor states; reference-limit cases remain in thorough runs.
All inherited corpora, deterministic mixed operations, invariants and minimized regressions.
